title: ocpp-tap event envelope, v1
description: Fields every v1 event carries. Each event type's schema refers to this one and narrows type, connector_id, timestamp and data. See README.md.

schema_version.description: Always "1" for this schema. A breaking change is a new major version.

id.description: UUIDv7, lowercase. Unique per event and time-ordered: within one octap process, a later event has a greater id.

type.description: The event type, e.g. "connector.status". Consumers ignore types they don't know.

charger_id.description: The charge point identity: the last segment of the URL path the charger dialled.

connector_id.description: OCPP connector id. 0 means the charge point as a whole. null only where the event type allows it (a transaction.stopped whose start octap did not see).

timestamp.description: The time the charger put in the frame, in UTC. null when the frame carries none.

received_at.description: When octap read the frame (or saw the connection change), in UTC, up to nanosecond precision.
